newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: New Cap says could exceed 1997 forecasts.
newsitem.headline: New Cap says could exceed 1997 forecasts.

text.p: New Cap Reinsurance Corp Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it expected, barring major catastrophe losses, to meet and possibly exceed its calendar 1997 forecasts issued in last year's prospectus.

"Looking forward, we feel it would be reasonable to expect, considering the current level of claim activity and barring major catastrophe losses, that our calendar year results should meet and possibly surpass our original prospectus forecast," New Cap said in a statement accompanying its half year result.
New Cap, which was formed last year, reported a net profit of A$342,000 for the six months ended March 31.

New Cap's prospectus forecast A$225 million of gross written premium in the current year, which it expected to grow to A$600 million by 2001. Operating profit was forecast to grow from A$20 million to A$106 million over the same period.
The Bermuda-domiciled company raised A$10.1 million through an Australian share issue.
